name: Synthetic Turf Fields
description:
This dataset is an inventory of 338 synthetic turf fields and related facilities, likely maintained by a city parks or recreation department. Each record describes a single turf installation, identified by a system ID and linked to a parent site, with details on its location, borough, and description (for example, a playground, dog run, or soccer field). Records distinguish the type of system (field group, play area, or dog run), the turf type (infill or non-infill), and the infill material, such as coated sand, uncoated sand, or rubber crumb.

The data also covers who is responsible for upkeep and construction, including the maintaining agency and any named partner organization, the construction entity and contractor, contract type and number, and the date the facility was commissioned. A status field indicates whether each installation is active, inactive, removed, archived, or pending, and a retired flag is included. Borough is recorded as a single-letter code (B, M, Q,
